value.rationale: The defining paper itself uses this regular octagon as a concrete benchmark, so establishing that its proposed quotient is not merely larger than the reported lower bound but actually unbounded is a natural and consequential boundary result. The finding identifies a structural denominator singularity with an exact path rather than an arbitrary numerical counterexample, and it directly informs whether the quantity can serve as a finite geometric constant without additional restrictions.
